items.title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
items.summary: Speaking at Token2049 in Singapore, the chairman said Bitmine is about 100,000 ETH—roughly six to seven weeks—from its 5% cap, setting an end date on a buying spree that made it the world's largest Ethereum treasury.
